decisions.reason: The lubrication system remains a low-cost option in a growing niche, and with no negative performance signals the firm keeps it open while market uncertainty persists.
The hydrocyclone filter aligns with the firm's core filtration capabilities, so the option value of retaining it outweighs the modest cost of continued offering.
The gravity band filter serves similar industrial fluid needs and, absent evidence of failure, the firm keeps this option open as part of its modular portfolio.
